edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/fs/bcachefs/btree_io.c
+++ /linux/fs/bcachefs/btree_io.c
@@ -1133,0 +1134,7 @@
+
+			if (btree_err_on(vstruct_bytes(b->data) > btree_buf_bytes(b),
+					 -BCH_ERR_btree_node_read_err_must_retry,
+					 c, ca, b, i, NULL,
+					 bset_past_end_of_btree_node,
+					 "btree node header too large"))
+				goto fsck_err;
@@ -1136,0 +1144,7 @@
+
+			if (btree_err_on(vstruct_bytes(bne) > btree_buf_bytes(b) - (b->written << 9),
+					 -BCH_ERR_btree_node_read_err_must_retry,
+					 c, ca, b, i, NULL,
+					 bset_past_end_of_btree_node,
+					 "btree node bset too large"))
+				goto fsck_err;
